==Behind the scenes==
Tihar was mentioned in the [[Legacy (2006) 23|twenty-third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]]<ref name="Legacy23" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 7]], [[2008]].<ref name="darkhorseprofile">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/14-884/Star-Wars-Legacy-23|text=Star Wars: Legacy #23}}</ref>
